title: Latest reported figures: 1,222 confirmed dead
body: These figures are read automatically from the published reports as they appear, and are not written or checked by hand. confirmed dead: 1,222, up from 1,204, reported by Nepal Police. rescued: 11,993, up from 8,730, reported by Nepalnews.
Where a report describes one district or one stretch of river rather than the national figure, it is not used here. Out of contact does not mean dead.
